unet: TRAIN (proof passed its purpose): from-scratch, synthetic-only, 1.56 M params, transfers to real sheets (exterior-wall recall 0.91-1.00) and reads the decisive round-8 gaps (cyklamenach window 97 % opening, gozdzikowcach garage door 75 % opening, porch mouth 100 % background). Adds ~0 exterior-wall coverage over source-cv: its value is the OPENING class at gap seams, not more wall. NOT a referee yet: real gap questions are one-sided (minority 10/12 right, 2 confident wrong), WALL_CONTINUATION rule unresolved on the gozdzikowcach porch mouth (pier read 36 % wall), synthetic open-gap shortcut (12 confident wrong CONTINUES). Basis for 005K.
segformer: DEFER: MiT-B0 (3.71 M; independent re-implementation, not clean-room — its structure follows the Apache-2.0 PVTv2 / HF code) at the same budget is slower (4.5 s vs 1.2 s per 864^2 frame in WASM, >= 928 vs >= 340 MiB), reads fewer real openings (0.58-0.81 vs 0.72-0.90) and misses the gozdzikowcach garage door (82 % background); fewer false walls inside exclusions (<= 0.8 % vs <= 3.6 %) and no synthetic confident-wrong, but 20 confident-wrong on REAL_DEV gap questions. Revisit only if 005K's UNet cannot meet the false-wall gate.
routeCPilot: PILOT RESULT: NEGATIVE ON REAL. A 1.07 M-param image-level classifier trained only on synthetic question images learns the synthetic task (85 % on held-out seeds, 2.7 % confident-wrong at 0.80, 0 at >= 0.98) but does not transfer: REAL_DEV 49.7 % (below the 76 % majority floor), 34 % confident-wrong at 0.80, still 1.2 % at 0.999. Image-level questions need real-style data and/or a pixel-level observation underneath; feasible on device (70 ms per question in WASM).
overall: The commercially clean, transferable piece is a pixel-level wall/opening observation model trained from scratch on BuildPlan synthetic data (UNet-lite). Whole-image referees (generic small VLMs zero-shot, and a from-scratch synthetic classifier) do not transfer to real sheets at the confident-wrong bar.
